notes.title: Bullet Heaven 2.0 Event + Patch 0.1.23
notes.content:
[b]Patch 0.1.23 update[/b]
We're bringing a small update to the demo, with new skill evolutions, quality of life improvements and balancing. While we're preparing a new content update soon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927335/1fcdd9bfa89d18ac26411e301e87c2bb4f5341a8.png[/img]

Some changes and additions:
[list]
[*] Changing the game time in normal from 20 minutes -> 15 minutes (We want to make the game more dynamic in low difficulties)
[*] Skills HUD in the Lobby, now shows the skill icon correctly: Summon and Defensive
[*] Changing: All map events in normal every 4 minutes -> every 3 minutes
[*] Adding Immunity Barrier when picking up artifact for 10s, and new HUD showing immunity time (Only for Exp Share in multiplayer)
[*] New skill evolution: Warrior: War Flag -> Power Flag
[*] New skill evolution: Archer: Rain of Arrows -> Tactic Rain
[*] New skill evolution: General: Note Tuneless -> Unstable Note
[*] New skill evolution: Rogue: Caltrop -> Spike Trap
[*] And a small rebalance to suit the new game progression
[/list]

Let us know what you think of these changes so we can keep improving the game.
Thanks for your attention,
LV99 Studios

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 Rogue update is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927335/2fa5255bcdb48bbdd776ab9ddb26925291f8d60c.gif[/img]

[b]Patch 0.1.2 Rogue update![/b]

We're bringing you a new update for the demo! With a new character, quality of life, enemies, new events and more. Our new character: the Rogue, brings a very unique kit compared to the current characters and those planned for the final game, he works with bleeding and gadgets that help him in his fights, we want the player to feel like they were really playing with an RPG rogue, but within our universe, we dedicated a lot of time and care to bring this character and we hope you like it

Some changes and additions:

[list]
[*] New character Rogue, with 8 unique skills and 3 evolved skills
[*] 6 New synergies with his duplicate skills for the Rogue
[*] New introduction when entering maps with your main objective
[*] New tutorial for the Duplicate skill
[*] New suggestion button in the main menu
[*] Duplicate skills now show an indicative icon before picking them up for the first time
[*] Now shows the description correctly for skills with unique Lock mechanics
[*] New icon for skills with Lock mechanics
[*] Elites now has a chance of dropping life
[*] New events have been added to the Elven Forest map
[*] New hud that shows the changes in the abilities made by the artifacts
[*] New enemy: Poison Mushroom, when defeated it releases a toxic cloud that follows the closest hero and causes damage
[*] Changing the game balance to adapt to the new changes
[/list]

And finally, a little preview of what's possible with the rogue's new skill kit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927335/af897c96dd7444847fa284b655629a3ca79863d0.gif[/img]

Please let us know what you think of these changes so we can improve the game even more.

Thanks for your attention,
LV99 Studios

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 Demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone, through community feedback we are bringing some improvements, bug fixes and quality of life to the demo, including some balancing, we saw that the demo in general is very easy which may leave something to be desired for several players, for even though our intention is just to demonstrate aspects of the game, we still want players to feel some kind of challenge, so we are going to make the game a little more difficult, some of the main changes are: increase in the general speed of all enemies and quantity of enemies, more damage to the boss and less cooldown time for your skills and new indicator in the Crimson plant event buff (that's what we call it), visual indicator in skill improvements, new sounds, etc. You can see more about the changes below

list of changes:
[list]
[*]Correcting artifact text that did not correctly display the current buff value
[*]Changing bonus damage artifact description from "plus bonus damage +x%" to "plus total damage +x%"
[*]Increasing speed of all enemies
[*]Increasing amount of experience gained
[*]Increasing the number of enemies
[*]Adding Hell chicken monster to appear in the end times of the game
[*]Decreasing the cooldown of the cursed tree boss's pine cone attack from 5 to 4.5
[*]Increasing damage from all boss attacks
[*]Crimson Plant Speed ​​buff increased from 15% to 20%
[*]Decreasing speed artifact buff from 0.3 to 0.15
[*]Decreasing initial re-roll amount from 7 to 4
[*]New visual indicator for skill upgrades with massive power boost
[*]New visual indicator for skill upgrades that can evolve
[*]Crimson Plant now releases visual effects on enemies when granting a buff
[*]Crimson plant when fleeing now shows its way underground
[*]Reducing time needed to revive in multiplayer
[*]Now the configuration for showing life starts with: show with number
[*]New sounds for: Level up, Artifact, boss attacks, events, breaking boxes and much more...
[/list]
Please let us know what you think of these changes so we can improve the game even more.
Thank you for your attention,
LV99 Studios

notes.title: Pixel Quest: Survivor - The Demo is live!
notes.content:
We're happy to share our first look at Pixel Quest: Survivor with you, and we're excited to hear if you think it's fun too! This demo contains the following feature:

[list]
[*]3 playable characters, each with their own unique attacking, defensive skills and attributes.
[*]11 Warrior skills, 8 for basic skills and 3 for evolved skills.
[*]11 Archer skills, 8 for basic skills and 3 for evolved skills.
[*]11 Rogue skills, 8 for basic skills and 3 for evolved skills.
[*]5 General skills, 4 for basic skills and 1 for evolved skills.
[*]38 skills in total counting Warrior, Archer, Rogue and general skills and their evolutions.
[*]An unlockable skill during the game, “Duplicate” that allows you to use the same skill multiple times, creating unique synergies with your copies!
[*]A themed map, sub-boss and boss.
[*]And fully functional online co-op up to 4 players!
[/list]
If you have any suggestions, ideas, criticisms, bug reports, etc., that you would like to make for the game to make it more fun, please let us know! Through the in-game form in the pause menu, Pixel Quest: Survivor is still in development and we want to improve our game, through the community and your sincere feedback we can take this game to the next Level!

Edited to include new character Rogue

Thank you for your attention,
LV99 Studios
